sentences.en: My neighbours have a big dog.

sentences.ar: הוא חום ויש לו עיניים שחורות.
sentences.en: He's brown and has black eyes.

sentences.ar: כל בוקר הם הולכים איתו ברחוב.
sentences.en: Every morning they walk him in the street.
He likes to run after cats.
Sometimes he makes noise at night.
But he's a good, quiet dog.
